query: SELECT id, sponsorId, attendeeId, matchReason FROM meetings WHERE matchReason LIKE '%Zinc%' OR matchReason LIKE '%competitor%' OR matchReason LIKE '%opted in%';

rows.matchReason: Delegate's pain point 'reviewing how assessments can improve quality of hire and therefore reduce attrition' and interest in 'latest capabilities (inc AI) of technology in the assessment' is directly addressed by Maki's 'in-depth assessments' and focus on 'highly predictive hiring decisions that drive on-the-job success' and 'lower attrition'. Note: delegate currently uses AON for assessments, which is a competitor. (Ranked in sponsor's top 20 preferred delegates)

Delegate's pain point 'Reduce time-to-hire without compromising quality of hire' and interest in 'AI Screening (Top funnel), On-demand interview (High Volume Assessment), Ai Noteraker' is a direct match for Maki's 'autonomous AI agents' for 'skill screening, conversational interviews, in-depth assessments' which 'accelerate time to hire' and 'improve candidate experience'. Note: delegate currently uses HireVue for assessments, which is a competitor.

Delegate's pain point 'Reviewing assessment tools to funnel good quality candidates through the application process' is a direct match for Maki's 'in-depth assessments' and 'skill based screening' designed to make 'highly predictive hiring decisions'. Note: delegate currently uses Codility and Cappfinity for assessments, which are competitors.

Delegate's 'Active / Confirmed Projects: Assessment Tech, AI' and interest in 'AI, Assessment tech, Skills' is a direct match for Maki's 'advanced AI to streamline every step of the talent acquisition journey' and its 'skill screening, conversational interviews, in-depth assessments'. Note: delegate currently uses Sova, SHL, Cappfinity, Codility for assessments, which are competitors. (Ranked in sponsor's top 20 preferred delegates)

Delegate's pain point 'skills based hiring' and interest in 'Agentic AI' is a direct match for Maki's 'skill based screening and conversational assessments' and its 'autonomous AI agents' that enable 'highly predictive hiring decisions'. Note: delegate currently uses Sapia, SHL, Korn Ferry for assessments, which are competitors. (Ranked in sponsor's top 20 preferred delegates)

Delegate's pain point 'Humanising AI in processes' and interest in 'AI developments for sourcing' aligns with Maki's 'commitment to fairness and accuracy, backed by science-audited AI and explainable scoring' and its 'autonomous AI agents' for screening and assessments. Note: delegate currently uses Talogy for assessments, which is a competitor.

Delegate is 'keen to look at technology in both vetting & on-boarding' and has 'vetting & on-boarding' as an active project, which Zinc's automated background checks directly address to improve efficiency and reduce processing time. (Ranked in sponsor's top 20 preferred delegates)
Delegate explicitly states 'Would be interested in background checking vendors' as a meeting objective, directly aligning with Zinc's offering. Note: delegate will be using Pinpoint ATS from June.

Delegate has 'Background Checks' as an active project and is looking for 'Better understanding of how the solutions 'are better' than existing partnerships/solutions', which Zinc directly offers. Note: delegate currently uses Workday ATS. (Ranked in sponsor's top 20 preferred delegates)

Delegate explicitly lists 'Background Screening' and 'Compliance' as active projects and meeting objectives, directly matching Zinc's core product and compliance focus. Note: delegate currently uses Oleeo ATS.

Delegate is looking for 'instruments to improve experience on pre-onboarding and onboarding stages' and 'process automation', which Zinc's automated background checks and real-time status updates can directly enhance.

Delegate's pain points include 'automation' and 'system standardisation', which Zinc's automated and integrated background check solution can support as part of a wider tech stack. (Ranked in sponsor's top 20 preferred delegates)

Delegate explicitly opted in to meet Zinc — a deliberate signal of interest in background screening solutions. Delegate explicitly opted in to meet Zinc (a direct Veremark competitor) and lists "Screening" as a current pain point — a clear signal of active vendor evaluation in the background screening space.
